posts.text:
The Star. A young woman in a plain white robe kneels by a pool at night, pouring water from one red jug into the pool and from the other onto the grass. After the storm, a clear night.

The reflection: you will meet someone this week who renews your faith. The stars have already chosen them for you.

For today: Do one small thing that restores you: a walk, water, an early night.

What small thing gives you hope right now, and how could you tend it?

Follow for tomorrow's card.

Ask the cards your own question at https://edomoon.com

posts.title: Four of Swords tarot card meaning, upright and reversed
posts.text:
Four of Swords. Three blades on the wall, one at his side, and he sleeps.

Upright: Rest, taken on purpose. The fight is over for now, and the body needs quiet to mend. Lie down, close the door, let the mind go still.
Reversed: Rest refused, or rest that has turned into hiding. Either you are running on empty, or it is time to get up and walk back into the day.

For today: Put the phone in another room for twenty minutes and rest on purpose.

The full meaning: https://edomoon.com/cards/four-of-swords

Three blades on the wall, one at his side. When did you last rest without first having to earn it?

Upright: A call to action. The sword at his side is ready, and the moment to charge ahead is now. Move fast while the road is open.
Reversed: Hesitation. The fight waits, and every hour spent lying still is ground given away.

For today: Put the phone in another room for twenty minutes and rest on purpose.
